Executive Strategic Blueprint — Prepared by XPM Agency for Tech Nebraska

The Hero’s Journey of Nebraska Technology.

Every great movement is framed around a story. Most organizations fail because they make themselves the hero. Tech Nebraska wins by positioning our state’s technology builders as the heroes, and Tech Nebraska as their trusted legislative, peer, and platform guide.

"Your business is not the hero of your brand story. Your customer is. When you position the customer as the hero and yourself as the guide, everything changes." — Donald Miller, StoryBrand

The 7-Part StoryBrand Framework Step 1 of 7

The Transformation Matrix: From Isolated to Connected

Status Quo • The Isolated Struggle

Before Joining Tech Nebraska

  • ❌
    Corporate Silos: Enterprise technology leaders tackle AI governance, cyber threats, and compliance in complete isolation without peer validation.
  • ❌
    Flyover State Stigma: Coastal investors and national media dismiss Midwest innovation as purely agricultural, overlooking massive enterprise infrastructure.
  • ❌
    Talent & Capital Flight: Top software graduates leave Nebraska every May for Austin or Chicago; founders feel forced to relocate headquarters to raise Series A.
  • ❌
    Uncoordinated Policy: Critical economic incentives like the Business Innovation Act (BIA) face defunding because tech lacks an organized legislative presence.
Tech Nebraska Powered • The Prairie Powerhouse

After Engaging Tech Nebraska

  • ✅
    Unified Statewide Coalition: Direct peer access across HDR, Union Pacific, Kiewit, Mutual of Omaha, and dozens of high-growth tech ventures.
  • ✅
    Pragmatic Innovation Leadership: Nebraska recognized nationally as the capital of Applied Industrial AI, AgTech, and mission-critical enterprise resilience.
  • ✅
    Brain Gain & Talent Retention: High-paying tech careers paired with Nebraska's unmatched quality of life keep engineering leaders and founders anchored in-state.
  • ✅
    Legislative Clout: Over $15 Million in BIA funding championed in partnership with the Nebraska Chamber, creating a thriving regulatory and capital tailwind.
